collections.thisCollectionComesFrom: This collection comes from TMDB. You can rename it and change its description.
collections.name: Name
collections.onlyWhatThePerson: Only what the person watching hasn't seen
collections.nothingMatchesYetIt: Nothing matches yet. It'll fill up as titles are added.
collections.gridCollection: Show the collection instead of its titles
collections.gridBoth: Show the collection and its titles
collections.inheritedCollection: Library default (show the collection instead of its titles)
collections.inheritedBoth: Library default (show the collection and its titles)
collections.smartShow: A smart collection holds every show that matches, and keeps itself up to date.
collections.smartVideo: A smart collection holds every video that matches, and keeps itself up to date.
collections.smartMovie: A smart collection holds every movie that matches, and keeps itself up to date.
collections.manualShows: Add shows to it from their pages (⋯ > Add to Collection), in any order.
collections.manualVideos: Add videos to it from their pages (⋯ > Add to Collection), in any order.
collections.manualMovies: Add movies to it from their pages (⋯ > Add to Collection), in any order.

bulkEdit.makeTheseOneMovie: Make these one movie, as versions
bulkEdit.changesApplyToEvery: Changes apply to every title you chose. Anything you leave empty stays as it is.
bulkEdit.unlockedFieldsGoBack: Unlocked fields go back to the online details at the next refresh. Use Refresh to do it now.
bulkEdit.theyBecomeOneMovie: They become one movie, with each file as a version you can choose when playing. Watch history, ratings, playlists and collections come along.
bulkEdit.splitAMovieApart: Split a movie apart again from its ⋯ menu if you change your mind.
bulkEdit.refreshNotice: Refreshing in the background. Follow it in Activity.
bulkEdit.theyBecomeOneShow: They become one show. Episodes they both have keep every file; the rest move across. Watch history, ratings, playlists and collections come along.
bulkEdit.showsCantSplit: The kept show's episode orders stay; the others' own orders and manual placements are dropped. Shows can't be split apart again.

optimize.thoseCopiesAreAlready: Those copies are already made or on their way.
optimize.showingTheLastLoaded: Showing the last loaded optimized copies. They may be out of date.
optimize.noneYetChooseOptimize: None yet. Choose Optimize from a title's ⋯ menu, or Select titles in a library, to make easy-to-play copies ahead of time.
optimize.fullHd: Full HD, about 3.5 GB an hour
optimize.phoneQuality: For phones and slow connections, about 1.8 GB an hour
optimize.description_one: Make an easy-to-play copy of {{title}} ahead of time, so players that can't play it as it is (or remote ones) don't have to wait for it to be converted. Copies are kept in Arc's data folder; your files aren't touched.
optimize.description_other: Make an easy-to-play copy of {{count}} titles ahead of time, so players that can't play them as they are (or remote ones) don't have to wait for it to be converted. Copies are kept in Arc's data folder; your files aren't touched.
optimize.queued_one: {{count}} copy queued. They're made one at a time in the background; follow them in Activity.
optimize.queued_other: {{count}} copies queued. They're made one at a time in the background; follow them in Activity.

playbackOptions.automaticUsesYourProfile: Automatic uses your profile preferences, falling back to this file’s available tracks. Choosing another version resets its track choices.
playbackOptions.languageChoicesAreRemembered: Language choices are remembered when you play, just like in the player. Arc may adapt audio or video for this browser; source formats do not guarantee device output.
